intro: The sticker manager has three parts. The library stores stickers by category, with text descriptions. The collector gathers stickers other people post in allowed group chats. The injector tells the model how to send stickers with <meme>category</meme>, and swaps the tags for sticker messages before sending. The description and category model is set under "Models & Services → Routes → Sticker description and category model", and semantic search uses the Embedding route.

categories.hint: The name is used in <meme>name</meme> tags: lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores, starting with a letter. The description tells the model and the category check what the category expresses. After renaming or deleting a category, its stickers need to be recategorized before they can be sent at random.
